# KeyLight API Dashboard — full machine-readable summary

KeyLight is a client-only API dashboard built with React, TypeScript, Vite, and Tailwind CSS. It is deployed as static assets on Cloudflare Pages. There is no server-side component.

## Architecture

Browser
  -> downloads static HTML/CSS/JS from Cloudflare Pages
  -> sends API requests directly to https://api.deepseek.com
  -> renders the returned JSON in the page

No application backend, Cloudflare Worker, API proxy, serverless function, database, KV, D1, or R2 is used.

## Data shown

Only these documented read-only DeepSeek endpoints are used:

1. GET https://api.deepseek.com/models
2. GET https://api.deepseek.com/user/balance

The UI displays:
- `is_available` and every `balance_infos` currency returned by the balance endpoint.
- Model ID, display name, owner, context window, maximum output tokens, modalities, and effort levels returned by the models endpoint.

The UI does not display, infer, or request:
- usage history or token-consumption totals;
- account ID, plan, tier, or creation date;
- estimated spending derived from balance;
- any simulated or sample account data.

The dashboard requires the user to supply their own DeepSeek API key. The browser places it only in the `Authorization` header. No billable chat/completion request is made by the dashboard.

## API key privacy

- Key lifetime: current page memory only.
- `localStorage` contains only non-sensitive theme and language preferences.
- `sessionStorage` is not used for credentials; startup code removes legacy credential entries from older builds.
- No key in URL, query, fragment, console, logs, or error strings.
- No analytics or error reporting.
- Clear Key clears memory and aborts the current operation.
- The site makes requests only to its own static assets and `https://api.deepseek.com`.
- The API key is not sent to Telegram, Discord, or any community endpoint.

## CORS

On 2026-10-26, browser preflight requests to both official endpoints returned HTTP 200 with:
- `access-control-allow-origin: <request origin>`
- `access-control-allow-methods: GET`
- `access-control-allow-headers: authorization`
- `access-control-allow-credentials: true`

If CORS is disabled by the provider, the UI reports a browser/network error and does not attempt a proxy.

## API Access and community

- API Access is advertised at 10% off the standard price.
- No checkout or payment form is present on this website.
- Website copy directs interested users to the Telegram or Discord community for details.
- Telegram: https://t.me/+mErIcVI3_R4zMDE1
- Discord: https://discord.gg/UEZGQTTDj
- Any community transaction is outside this website. The site does not process payments, issue keys, or receive keys through the communities.
- The website is not an official DeepSeek store, reseller, partner, or authorized agent.
